label: Sonic
description: Cocky, impatient, and personally insulted by the speed limit.
direction: Speak fast, bright and cocky, like a teenage hero with attitude: breezy, confident, a little impatient. Slow down just enough that the direction word lands clearly.
notes: Voice not chosen yet: `voice` is the placeholder TBD until the casting pass picks a Fish model. Speed jokes are everywhere except the plain prompts, and he always ends up obeying the limit. Catchphrases sit on greetings and road prompts; turns stay plain.

rights.author: Sega (character created by Naoto Ohshima, Yuji Naka and Hirokazu Yasuhara)
rights.pd_basis: None. Sega holds copyright and trademark in the character. Sonic has been voiced by several performers, among them Roger Craig Smith in the games and Ben Schwartz in the films, both living.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo well-known lines from the source work; those echoes are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.
The character's name, which is a live trademark.
Any recorded voice performance of the character, by any performer.

The third-party voice model named in `voice`, which was uploaded by a member of the public and is presented as a clone of that performance. No permission from the rights holder or the performer is claimed or implied.
Any commercial use. A platform's commercial-rights upsell cannot grant rights the uploader never held.
rights.notes: This preset is in copyright and says so. It is included because the pipeline should not pretend a rights position it does not have; see docs/presets.md before publishing anything built from it. The public-domain presets are pooh, eeyore and tigger.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1000_meters: In one kilometer. That's about two seconds for me.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Way past cool.
lines.in_one_mile: In one mile. Piece of cake.
lines.start_drive_1: Sonic's the name, speed's my game! Let's roll.
lines.start_drive_2: Gotta go fast! Well, speed limit fast.
lines.start_drive_3: Way past cool! Road trip time.
lines.start_drive_4: Come on, step it up! I could run there quicker.
lines.start_drive_5: Let's do it to it! Try to keep up.
lines.start_drive_6: Time to juice and jam! Buckle up.
lines.start_drive_7: Hey, Tails could fly us, but sure, we'll drive.
lines.start_drive_8: The Blue Blur is on navigation. Piece of cake.
lines.start_drive_9: Ready? Chili dogs when we get there. Go!
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. Whoa, overshot it! Happens when you're fast.
lines.arrived: We're here! Too easy. Now, where are the chili dogs?
lines.exit_fifth: take the fifth exit. Way past cool!
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. Just like a loop de loop.
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. Now I'm dizzy.
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. Aw, man. You're too slow!
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Somebody lost all their rings.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead! Watch out, could be spikes.
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Okay, okay. Gotta go slow.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Hit the brakes! I'll just tap my foot.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. Easy on the speed. I've got a reputation.
lines.reroute_chime: Whoops, blew right past it! No sweat. New route.
